adultPopulationShare.estimatedFrom: U.S. Census national age distribution: approximately 78 percent age 18 or older; applied to the recorded government population where an adult count is unavailable

pastMonthUseShare.estimatedFrom: SAMHSA NSDUH state estimates: approximate national adult past-month marijuana-use share pending place-specific compilation

monthlySpendingPerUser.estimatedFrom: State retail sales / users: approximate monthly dollars per past-month user pending matched state sales and NSDUH denominators

exciseRate.estimatedFrom: Median retail cannabis tax-rate terms in starting-law-2026/business-commerce.json; used only when the adopted law has no recorded numeric rate

legalRetailBase.estimatedFrom: CTO-approved aggregate legal-retail base: adult residents x past-month use x monthly spending; no individual purchasing decision is inferred
